# scm_dlp_config_import (Action)

Imports an Enterprise DLP tenant configuration bundle (/v1/api/configuration/import) or resolves conflicts on an existing import job (/v1/api/configuration/import/job/{id}?action=...).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import a DLP configuration bundle previously produced by scm_dlp_config_export,
# overwriting conflicting objects.
#
# Usage:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.scm_dlp_config_import.restore

action "scm_dlp_config_import" "restore" {
  config {
    file_path       = "${path.module}/dlp-config-export.json"
    conflict_action = "OVERWRITE"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `conflict_action` (String) Optional conflict resolution action to apply via PUT /v1/api/configuration/import/job/{id}?action=... (OVERWRITE, REFRESH, CONTINUE, or CANCEL).
- `file_content` (String) Raw content of the configuration export file to upload.
- `file_name` (String) Filename to send in the multipart upload (defaults to basename of file_path or 'dlp-config-export.json').
- `file_path` (String) Path to the configuration export file to upload. Either file_path, file_content, or (import_job_id + conflict_action) must be provided.
- `import_job_id` (String) Existing import job ID when applying a conflict resolution action without uploading a new file.
